svg.title: LADS scheduling overview and illustrative quota turnover
svg.desc: Panel a retains Cache-first, bounded turnover priority, transport commitment, native allocation and engine-side FIFO leases. Panel b compares the same B and C cached blocks before and after B resumes. A separate logical-quota rail shows B's exclusive protection quota returning and possibly funding a FIFO lease on C's own resident prefix. B's native request must own all leased blocks and successfully allocate at least one new token before its extra lease references retire. B continues using the same physical blocks. C remains subject to lease-grant conditions. A, B and C identify tool results and associated model histories, defined in the caption.
